chunks: If you wish to depart from Mina on the fourth day of the Day of Sacrifice, then depart when the sun has risen, and there is no issue upon you whatever hour you depart, whether you performed the stoning before noon or after it. If you wish to depart in the first departure, which is the third day, then depart when the sun has passed the zenith, for it is not permitted for you to depart before the sun’s zenith. If you remain until the sun sets, then you may not leave Mina, and it becomes obligatory upon you to remain until the fourth day of the Day of Sacrifice, which is the final departure. Proceed to Mecca proclaiming tahlil, glorification, and supplication. When you reach the Mosque of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, which is Masjid al-Hasba', enter it and lie in it on your back for as long as you rest. Whoever departs in the first departure, there is no obligation upon him to perform tahsib.

key_terms.مَسْجِدُ ٱلْحَصْبَاءِ: the mosque referred to here on the route after departing Mina
key_terms.مُهَلِّلًا: reciting tahlil, saying words of divine oneness and praise
key_terms.مِنًى: the location where pilgrims stay and perform rites during hajj
key_terms.يَوْمِ ٱلنَّحْرِ: the Day of Sacrifice during hajj
key_terms.ٱلزَّوَالِ: the sun’s passing the zenith, i.e. noon-time threshold
key_terms.ٱلنَّفْرُ: departure from Mina during the hajj rites

ai.seo_question: When is a pilgrim allowed to depart from Mina during hajj, and what happens if he remains until sunset?
ai.summary: This text sets out the fiqh rulings for departing from Mina during hajj, distinguishing between the first and final departures and specifying their permitted times. It also instructs the pilgrim to proceed to Mecca with dhikr and du'a and mentions entering Masjid al-Hasba' for a brief rest.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
If you wish to leave Mina on the fourth day of Eid al-Adha (the Day of Sacrifice), you may depart after sunrise, and it does not matter at what hour you leave, whether you cast the stones (at the pillars) before or after noon. However, if you wish to leave on the first departure (the third day of Eid al-Adha), you must wait until the sun has passed its zenith (noon), as it is not permissible to leave before this time. If you remain in Mina until sunset, then you are not allowed to leave Mina and must stay until the fourth day of Eid al-Adha, which is the final departure.
When you proceed to Mecca, do so while reciting Labbayk (Talbiyah), glorifying Allah (swt), and supplicating. Upon reaching the Mosque of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), which is known as Masjid al-Hasba, enter it and lie on your back for a brief rest.
For those who leave Mina on the first departure (the third day of Eid al-Adha), there is no obligation upon them to perform the ritual stoning (Hasba).
